request.title: Derek attacks the tree
request.prompt: Painterly dark-fantasy illustration in the style of a cinematic tabletop RPG book spread: wide 16:9 landscape composition, dramatic lighting with warm ember-orange highlights against cold ice-blue shadows, rich texture, a clear focal point. No text, no captions, no speech bubbles, no logos, no watermark. Scene: a chamber in the Grand Arena of Fireholm, reached through a glowing magical teleporter circle. The room is filled almost entirely by a large, gnarled tree. D.E.R.E.K. (also called Chadron): a humanoid golden construct with a smooth metal face, a single large glowing blue eye and full red lips, wearing hooded red-and-orange robes decorated with clockwork and clock-face motifs; he has just glided out of the teleporter and is attacking the tree in a panic, crackling golden time magic in his hands. The tree is really a disguised fairy: a small pair of translucent insect wings and a pair of alarmed green eyes can just be made out among the bark and branches. Behind, in the doorway, Durzo in his Grim Reaper form, the Grim Weeper: a lean half-elf rogue with swept-back silver-white hair and pointed ears, in fitted red-and-black leather armour, holding a pair of daggers, wrapped in a tattered black hooded shroud, looking on. Chaotic, comedic energy.
